name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-resto
description: MnemoResto : le restaurant qui n'oublie aucun client. Tableau de bord, plan de salle, réservations, CRM avec fidélité, serveurs et pourboires, menu, formules, TVA par produit, stock, caisse et facturation. Interface EN/FR/ES synchronisée avec Mnemosyne OS.

descriptionI18n.fr: MnemoResto : le restaurant qui n'oublie aucun client. Tableau de bord, plan de salle, réservations, CRM avec fidélité, serveurs et pourboires, menu, formules, TVA par produit, stock, caisse et facturation. Interface EN/FR/ES synchronisée avec Mnemosyne OS.
descriptionI18n.en: MnemoResto: the restaurant that never forgets a guest. Dashboard, floor plan, reservations, loyalty CRM, servers and tips, menu, combos, per-item VAT, stock, POS and invoicing. EN/FR/ES interface synced with Mnemosyne OS.
descriptionI18n.es: MnemoResto: el restaurante que no olvida a ningún cliente. Panel, plano de sala, reservas, CRM con fidelización, camareros y propinas, menú, combos, IVA por producto, stock, TPV y facturación. Interfaz EN/FR/ES sincronizada con Mnemosyne OS.

agentActions.summary: The dining room right now: each table's status (vacant, occupied, reserved, billed), seats, guest, waiter, reservation time and what is on order.
List or search the restaurant's clients: phone, email, allergies, preferences, favourite table, visits, loyalty points.
agentActions.details: query matches every word in the name, phone, email, allergies or preferences, accents ignored.

query.description: Words to look for; empty = every client.

agentActions.summary: The dishes on the menu with their category and price.
The ingredients in stock with their quantity, unit and alert threshold, and which ones are running low.
Show one tab of MnemoResto on the person's screen (dashboard, floor plan, clients, staff, menu, stock, till, invoices, settings).
Add a client to the restaurant's book, as the client form does, with allergies and preferences; their card shows in the Clients tab.
Change a client's phone, email, allergies, preferences or favourite table, as the client form does.
agentActions.details: Only the fields passed change; allergies replaces the whole list.

clientId.description: The client, by name as the person says it, or id.

agentActions.summary: Add (or take out) stock of an ingredient, as the stock form does; a new ingredient is created with its unit.
agentActions.details: An ingredient of the same name (any case), or the one ingredient the words name (« farine » for « Farine T55 »), gets the quantity added; several are refused (AMBIGUOUS); stock never goes below 0. unit is needed only for a new one. minThreshold left out (or 0) keeps the current threshold; a new ingredient gets 2, as the form does.

quantity.description: How much to add (negative takes it out).

minThreshold.description: Alert when stock is at or below this.

agentActions.summary: Show a table on the floor plan, selected as a click does, and answer its status, guest, waiter, reservation time and order.

table.description: The table, as the person says it (« table 4 », « la 4 ») or its id.

agentActions.summary: Change a table on the floor plan, as its pickers do: status (vacant, occupied, reserved), its waiter, its seats.
agentActions.details: Only what is passed changes. Leaving « reserved » drops the arrival time, as the floor plan does. A table waiting for its bill (billed) is changed at the till, never here.

table.description: The table, as the person says it or its id.

server.description: The waiter who covers it, by name.

agentActions.summary: Show the menu tab and answer one dish: category, price and its recipe (each ingredient, quantity and what is in stock).

dish.description: The dish, as the person says it, or its id.

agentActions.summary: Change a dish's price, name or category, as the menu form does; its recipe and VAT stay.
agentActions.details: Only what is passed changes. The price is in the restaurant's currency, rounded to the cent.

dish.description: The dish, as the person says it, or its id.

agentActions.summary: Open a client's card in the Clients tab, as a click in the list does, and answer it (allergies, preferences, favourite table, visits, points).

client.description: The client, by name as the person says it (« Dupont », « Jean Dupont »), or id.

agentActions.summary: Add a waiter to the staff, as the staff form does.
Change the restaurant's name or turn the loyalty programme on or off, as the settings page does.
Show or hide the AI copilot panel (it does nothing until the person writes in it).

open.description: true shows it, false hides it.

agentActions.summary: Close what is open: the invoice shown on top, else the selected table or client card.
agentActions.details: A confirmation box stays open: it is the person's to answer.

agentGuide: Name a table, a dish, a client or a waiter the way the person says it (« la table 4 », « le tiramisu », « Dupont »): MnemoResto finds it by its words. Several matches are refused with their names (AMBIGUOUS): pick one and call again.
To look at something: openTab for a screen (dashboard = the day's view), showTable, showDish (with its recipe), showClient, closeView to close.
A new price: editDish. A table free, seated or reserved, its waiter: setTable. A delivery or what ran out: restock (negative takes out).
Orders, bills, payments and invoices are the person's, at the till: there is no action for them.

fr: mets Léa sur la table cinq
passe le bœuf bourguignon à 18 euros
ouvre la fiche de Jean Dupont
en: set the beef bourguignon to 18 euros
es: pon a Léa en la mesa cinco
pon el bœuf bourguignon a 18 euros
abre la ficha de Jean Dupont
